limitations: Unmodified observations are unlabeled: review flags are not established false positives, and synthetic detections are not real-world recall.
Humidity is derived from temperature and dew point; independently injected changes can be physically inconsistent.
Windows overlap substantially and station-month samples were explored previously; results are not independent held-out evidence.
The ramp also changes historical baseline observations; the measured endpoint is the total injected change, not the change in the latest day.
This offline experiment does not modify telemetry, the live detector, incidents or notifications.
